title: BCA mobile
text: Financial Diary: Pemasukan sebesar IDR 8,127.00 dari ***PET **AK ***GSA di kategori Transfer Rekening.
notes: The incoming half of the GoPay -> BCA transfer; its pair is gopay/2026-08-06-transfer-keluar, 2.639s earlier.
Amount shape is the opposite of GoPay's: 'IDR ' with a space, comma thousands, two decimals. Both normalise to 8127 whole rupiah.
'***PET **AK ***GSA' is BCA's masking of 'DOMPET ANAK BANGSA' — GoPay's legal entity. The mask is stable enough to identify the counterparty wallet.
The title is the app name, not the event: 'BCA mobile' carries no information, so everything has to come out of text.
'di kategori Transfer Rekening' is BCA's own categorisation. It is not the merchant and does not belong in keterangan.
Channel is the Firebase fallback channel, which suggests BCA never declared a channel of its own — do not rely on it staying that way.
